label: Successor-chain borrowing link: An upstream natural-numbered node y is linked to downstream node x…
definition: An upstream natural-numbered node y is linked to downstream node x exactly when y = x + 1. This specifies abstract dependence order, not temporal duration, causal production, or an actual per se efficient cause.
note: Reuses the successor relation investigated by infinite local transmission, but gives the relation an explicit typed name for a limit-of-grounding construction. A real causal interpretation remains an independent bridge.
